title: Workspace logs
description: stdout and stderr of the prepare, test and run stages, as the workspace agents send them.

list.name: workspace
list.label: Workspace
list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT workspace FROM (
  SELECT LogAttributes['workspaceId'] AS workspace FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['workspaceId'] != ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT substring(ServiceName, 4) FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND startsWith(ServiceName, 'ws-')
) ORDER BY toUInt64OrZero(workspace)

query.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT workspace FROM (
  SELECT LogAttributes['workspaceId'] AS workspace FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['workspaceId'] != ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT substring(ServiceName, 4) FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND startsWith(ServiceName, 'ws-')
) ORDER BY toUInt64OrZero(workspace)

list.name: server
list.label: Server
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT LogAttributes['server'] FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['workspaceId'] IN (${workspace:singlequote}) ORDER BY 1

query.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT LogAttributes['server'] FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['workspaceId'] IN (${workspace:singlequote}) ORDER BY 1

list.name: stage
list.label: Stage
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT LogAttributes['stage'] FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['workspaceId'] IN (${workspace:singlequote}) ORDER BY 1

query.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT LogAttributes['stage'] FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['workspaceId'] IN (${workspace:singlequote}) ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, concat(LogAttributes['workspaceId'], ' / ', LogAttributes['server']) AS server, count() / $__interval_s AS value
FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['workspaceId'] IN (${workspace:singlequote}) AND LogAttributes['server'] IN (${server:singlequote}) AND LogAttributes['stage'] IN (${stage:singlequote}) AND $__conditionalAll(positionCaseInsensitive(Body, '$search') > 0, $search) GROUP BY time, server ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, concat(LogAttributes['workspaceId'], ' / ', LogAttributes['server']) AS server, count() / $__interval_s AS value
FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['workspaceId'] IN (${workspace:singlequote}) AND LogAttributes['server'] IN (${server:singlequote}) AND LogAttributes['stage'] IN (${stage:singlequote}) AND $__conditionalAll(positionCaseInsensitive(Body, '$search') > 0, $search) AND LogAttributes['source'] = 'stderr' GROUP BY time, server ORDER BY time

SELECT LogAttributes['workspaceId'] AS Workspace, LogAttributes['server'] AS Server, LogAttributes['stage'] AS Stage, count() AS Lines,
  countIf(LogAttributes['source'] = 'stderr') AS `stderr lines`, uniqExact(LogAttributes['replicaId']) AS Replicas, max(Timestamp) AS `Last line`
FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['workspaceId'] IN (${workspace:singlequote}) AND LogAttributes['server'] IN (${server:singlequote}) AND LogAttributes['stage'] IN (${stage:singlequote}) AND $__conditionalAll(positionCaseInsensitive(Body, '$search') > 0, $search) GROUP BY Workspace, Server, Stage ORDER BY Lines DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Logs

targets.rawSql:
SELECT Timestamp AS timestamp, Body AS body, multiIf(SeverityNumber >= 17, 'error', SeverityNumber >= 13, 'warning', 'info') AS level,
  LogAttributes['workspaceId'] AS workspace, LogAttributes['server'] AS server, LogAttributes['replicaId'] AS replica,
  LogAttributes['stage'] AS stage, LogAttributes['stepNumber'] AS step
FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['workspaceId'] IN (${workspace:singlequote}) AND LogAttributes['server'] IN (${server:singlequote}) AND LogAttributes['stage'] IN (${stage:singlequote}) AND $__conditionalAll(positionCaseInsensitive(Body, '$search') > 0, $search)
ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 1000

panels.description: stderr lines are shown as errors.
